arenas.name: Verdant Ruins
arenas.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: full-screen scenery-only battle background for a turn-based fantasy game.
Input images: IMAGE 1 is the existing arena to redraw, preserving its location identity, landmarks and spacious battle-camera composition. IMAGE 2 is the approved character ART STYLE reference only: use its bold, angular cel-shaded visual language for the environment; do not include the character itself.
Primary request: Completely redraw IMAGE 1 as a polished stylized 2D animation/game background matching bold cel-shaded action characters. A substantial style transformation: large simplified graphic shapes, selective clean contour lines, rich controlled local colors, two or three clear hard-edged shadow tones, smooth nonpixelated edges. Simplify repeated architecture, foliage and textures greatly. Ground is calm with broad color shapes and a few paving lines or sand contours only. Distant scenery has softer contrast and lighter outlines than the characters so overlaid fighters stand out.
Composition: ONE wide 16:9 landscape background, full bleed. Gentle slightly elevated fixed battle view. Broad level uninterrupted fighting surface covers lower 50–55%. Horizon near 45% from top. Leave near fighter position x30%, feet y78% and far fighter position x64%, feet y64% completely free of objects. Keep key landmarks in upper middle distance. Keep upper corners and right edge calm enough for HUD and move buttons; no large foreground branches, rocks or pillars obstructing fighter positions. Ground should have mid-value colors and visible depth, not a blank void.
Avoid: photorealism, granular realistic surface texture, detailed tiny leaves, tiny stone chips, microdetail, 3D renders, pixel art, gritty brush texture, overly thick black background outlines, characters, silhouettes of people, creatures, crowds, UI, labels, text, numbers, frames, watermarks. The result is ONLY the arena scenery. Background fully opaque; no transparency.
Preserve scene: An ancient ruined circular courtyard in a deep temperate forest. Tall moss-covered broken arches and carved stone pillars in the middle distance, huge mature trees and a high green canopy framing the edges, sunbeams through leaves, a few ferns at the margins. Broad level foreground of smooth worn stone paving mixed with fine earthen moss, largely clear of grass and objects so fighters stand visibly. Lush emerald and sage, warm shafts of daylight, muted stone grey, magical but natural.
